turns.q: How do I use it properly the very first time?
turns.replyTail:
lation

To open a new key safe before a code is set, pull down the clear button, then turn the open dial.

For maximum security, install it flush to brick or concrete, not mortar, use the supplied security screws, and avoid placing it within 15 cm of a corner.

If you mean the C500 Pro specifically, the code setting guide is here:

Of course. The very first time, the main things are to set your own code, test it fully, and only then start using it.

A few key points:
• Your key safe does not come with a pre set code
• Choose a code that is memorable but not obvious
• Keep a note of it somewhere safe because there is no override or reset code
• It is recommended to set your code before installation

To open a new key safe before a code is set, pull down the clear button, then turn the open dial.

For maximum security, install it flush to brick or concrete, not mortar, use the supplied security screws, and avoid placing it within 15 cm of a corner.
